name: Droost Wiki
description: Agent-maintained codebase wiki substrate: an OKF markdown bundle with per-page provenance manifests, a Drush staleness report, and MCP tools that serve generation fact sheets and the bundle itself. Submodule of Droost.
project_description: Droost Wiki is the substrate for an agent-maintained codebase wiki. The wiki is an OKF (open knowledge format) markdown bundle stored at a configurable project-relative path (default docs/wiki), where each page carries a provenance manifest recording which source files it covers and their content hashes. A Drush staleness report (drush droost:wiki:status) classifies each page fresh / stale / orphaned / invalid / unmanaged and lists custom modules no page covers — this is the wiki work list. Three read-only MCP tools serve the workflow: droost_wiki_factsheet (the generation packet for one module — what an agent needs to write or refresh its page), droost_wiki_pages (list pages, read one bundle-relative .md page, or grep across pages; every read is PathGuard-contained and byte-capped), and droost_wiki_status (per-page freshness). Page composition and generation (PageComposer, WikiGenerator, optionally AI-assisted) plus the status report are driven from Drush (droost:wiki:status, droost:wiki:generate); the MCP tools are read-only. It provides a settings form (administer droost wiki), config schema, and services for hashing, frontmatter parsing, bundle reading and provenance. It depends on the Droost base module. This documents the 1.0.0-rc1 pre-release.
